features: 15W Qi2 Magnetic Wireless Charging: Experience the future of charging with the boAt PB330 Pro MagnaCharge 15W Qi2-certified wireless power bank. Hit 50% in just 28 minutes, compared to conventional wireless chargers that can take up to 55 minutes. That’s nearly 2X faster charging, powered by next-gen Qi2 magnetic charging that delivers improved efficiency, better alignment, and reduced energy loss.

Foldable Aluminium Stand: The foldable aluminium stand holds your phone at an optimal viewing angle. It is perfect for video calls, streaming or browsing. Use your device comfortably while it continues charging.

Reduced Heat Build-Up during Wireless Charging: The PB330 Pro MagnaCharge features precise Qi2 magnetic alignment with improved coil materials that minimises energy loss, helping lower heat generation during wireless charging. Reduced heat helps support better battery health and stable long-term performance.

10000mAh High-Density Battery: Powered by a 10000mAh high-density lithium-ion polymer cell, the PB330 Pro MagnaCharge is engineered for efficient power storage and longer life cycles. It intelligently handles daily phone charging needs, keeping you powered through travel, workdays, or long commutes.

22.5W Wired Fast Charging: Provides up to 22.5W power and supports standard fast-charging standards like PD, QC 3.0, and PPS. This helps compatible devices charge noticeably faster than regular charging, making it useful when you’re short on time, whether you’re between meetings, or topping up during travel.
